# Version

The operating system version, read through [`RtlGetVersion`](/docs/api/windows/version#rtl-get-version).

<h2 id="os-version-info-ex"><code>OsVersionInfoEx</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct OsVersionInfoEx {
    pub size: uint32;
    pub majorVersion: uint32;
    pub minorVersion: uint32;
    pub buildNumber: uint32;
    pub platformId: uint32;
    pub csdVersion: char16[N];
    pub servicePackMajor: uint16;
    pub servicePackMinor: uint16;
    pub suiteMask: uint16;
    pub productType: uint8;
    pub reserved: uint8;
}
```

The `RTL_OSVERSIONINFOEXW` that [`RtlGetVersion`](/docs/api/windows/version#rtl-get-version) fills in.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Version.rux#L9)

**Fields**

| Name               | Type        | Description                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------ | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `size`             | `uint32`    | The structure's size in bytes, `sizeof(OsVersionInfoEx)`, which the caller sets before the call.                                      |
| `majorVersion`     | `uint32`    | The major version: 10 for both Windows 10 and Windows 11.                                                                             |
| `minorVersion`     | `uint32`    | The minor version: 0 for both Windows 10 and Windows 11.                                                                              |
| `buildNumber`      | `uint32`    | The build number, such as 26100, which tells the releases apart.                                                                      |
| `platformId`       | `uint32`    | The platform: 2, [`VER_PLATFORM_WIN32_NT`](/docs/api/windows/version#ver-platform-win32-nt), on every supported release.              |
| `csdVersion`       | `char16[N]` | The NUL-terminated UTF-16 name of the latest service pack, empty on current releases.                                                 |
| `servicePackMajor` | `uint16`    | The major version of the latest service pack.                                                                                         |
| `servicePackMinor` | `uint16`    | The minor version of the latest service pack.                                                                                         |
| `suiteMask`        | `uint16`    | The `VER_SUITE_` bits saying which product suites are installed.                                                                      |
| `productType`      | `uint8`     | Whether this is a workstation, [`VER_NT_WORKSTATION`](/docs/api/windows/version#ver-nt-workstation), a domain controller or a server. |
| `reserved`         | `uint8`     | Reserved.                                                                                                                             |

<h2 id="rtl-get-version"><code>RtlGetVersion</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func RtlGetVersion(info: *var OsVersionInfoEx) -> int32
```

Reads the true version of the running system, whatever the program's manifest declares.
The caller sets `size` first; the call fills in every other field, `csdVersion` and the fields after it
included, because the size says the structure is the extended one. It returns an `NTSTATUS` rather than a
[`Bool`](/docs/api/windows/types#bool), and sets nothing [`GetLastError`](/docs/api/windows/errors#get-last-error) reports.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/windows-hardware/drivers/ddi/wdm/nf-wdm-rtlgetversion](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows-hardware/drivers/ddi/wdm/nf-wdm-rtlgetversion)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Version.rux#L54)

**Parameters**

| Name   | Type                   | Description                                                         |
| ------ | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `info` | `*var OsVersionInfoEx` | the structure to fill, with `size` set to `sizeof(OsVersionInfoEx)` |

**Returns**: zero, [`STATUS_SUCCESS`](/docs/api/windows/get-random#status-success), which is the only status the call returns
